author: THSV StreamBridge
description: Lets viewers spend points or channel points on short OBS screen effects or on exercises you do on camera, with a grace countdown, a safe scene, and monthly exercise totals.
changelog: 4.0.39: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.39, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.38: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.38, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.37: aligned with THSV StreamBridge 4.0.37, guided wizard UI, verified update metadata, and regenerated Streamer.bot imports. 4.0.36: added Streamer Punishments.

manifest.name: Streamer Punishments

actionsProvided.name: THSV Extension - Streamer Punishments - Set Filter
THSV Extension - Streamer Punishments - Switch Scene

installationSteps: In OBS, add one filter per screen effect to the source it should change and turn it off: for example a Color Correction filter named "THSV Blackout" with brightness turned down. Pixelate and barrel roll need the free Composite Blur and Move plugins.
Import the Streamer Punishments Streamer.bot package, approve Set Filter and Switch Scene in the wizard, and leave both triggerless.
Fill in each effect's OBS source and filter name, check the exercises, reps and prices, and pick the safe scene for exercises.
For Twitch and Kick, create channel point rewards with the same prices and paste each reward ID into its row.
Enable the extension and restart StreamBridge.
uninstallationSteps: Disable the extension. Any effect that is on turns off, and owed exercises stay saved until it is enabled again.

healthChecks.description: Confirms bounded punishment parsing, refunded point spending, one effect at a time, and one exercise at a time with a grace countdown.
